name: nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode
description: Internal (no auth). Guarantees the hasher holds a COMPLIANT invite code (HC.Hasher.ResetCode = 'URC:' + exactly six A-Z, checked in binary collation) and optionally rotates a compliant code older than @rotateIfOlderThanMinutes. The app's only account-recovery route is 'email me my invite code', so every live account must hold a usable one; this SP is the single place that defines compliant and mints a replacement (six random uppercase letters, up to ten attempts against a collision). Non-compliant covers the column default '######', NULL/empty, no 'URC:' prefix and anything not six uppercase letters. Removed accounts (Removed <> 0) are never touched. Callers: nonApi_getUserInviteCode (rotate at 10080 min), nonApi_getUserInviteCodeByPublicHasherId (no rotation), hcportal_approveKennelRequest, hcportal_bulkAddHashers, hcportal_getInviteEmailList, publicWeb_issuePasskeyInviteCode. Returns nothing — read HC.Hasher.ResetCode afterwards.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The hasher. No live row (Removed <> 0 or unknown) = silent no-op; the caller reports not found.

parameters.name: rotateIfOlderThanMinutes
parameters.description: NULL (default) = only replace a non-compliant code. A number also rotates a compliant code whose ResetCodeLastUpdated is older than that many minutes (or NULL). Pass NULL when the caller must NOT invalidate a code the user may just have been sent.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET ResetCode = 'URC:' + <6 letters>, ResetCodeLastUpdated = GETDATE() WHERE id = @userId AND Removed = 0 — fires the Hasher updatedAt trigger, so the hasher row re-syncs (the hashers rowset is global; ResetCode itself is never synced).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('Invite code generation exhausted') when ten consecutive candidates collide.
CATCH: ROLLBACK if any, INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('<unknown>'), THROW.

codeSmells.detail: @userId (line 2) has no SQL default. Every caller is an SP that always supplies it, so no client reaches the unlogged 500.

codeSmells.issue: Staleness measured with GETDATE() against a DATETIMEOFFSET column
codeSmells.detail: Line 70: DATEDIFF(minute, @lastUpdated, GETDATE()) compares a DATETIMEOFFSET(7) with server-local DATETIME; the write at line 98 also uses GETDATE(), so the two agree as long as the server stays on UTC.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
